decisions.reason: As a spray system that builds on the firm's core equipment business and remained on the website through 2024, it likely has low carrying costs and still retains option value despite limited public evidence on market traction.

The product is close to the established offer and still prominently presented, but the reference to a prior test phase suggests commercialization may still be maturing, so it is worth keeping while uncertainty resolves.
This product line reuses proven components, fits tightly with the firm's existing pump portfolio, and therefore looks like a low-cost option with relatively strong prospects to remain in the market.

Although it stayed on its own page through 2024, fire protection flow monitoring appears somewhat more adjacent to the firm's traditional core than the pump and spraying products, so it faces a higher but still not dominant risk of withdrawal.

As the newest launch and close to the firm's established offer, it is exactly the kind of product a medium-sized German engineering firm would usually retain for another year to learn about demand before committing to a withdrawal.
